title: Famous Pagoda
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: A non-decreasing sequence of N heights must be cut into G blocks of consecutive positions. A block costs the minimum over all integers v of the sum of |height - v| raised to the power k, where k is one or two. The task is to report the least achievable total cost over all such partitions, with N up to two thousand and G up to N.
